title: Request Jesse REST API to expose /exchanges endpoint
description: The REST config module needs Jesse to expose an /exchanges endpoint so we can query available exchanges dynamically. Currently hardcoded. See jesse_mcp/core/rest/config.py:12

title: Remove overlap with official Jesse MCP (strategy pivot)
description:
Jesse v2.1.4 ships a built-in MCP server covering strategy dev (backtest CRUD, candle import, strategy create/read/write, config). jesse-ops-mcp should focus exclusively on operational tools the official MCP does NOT provide: live trading, risk analysis, optimization execution, pairs trading, monitoring, and community tools.

Remove 12 overlapping tools and reposition the project as the "ops" complement to Jesse's built-in "strategy dev" MCP.

title: Remove overlapping backtesting tools from tools/backtesting.py
description:
Strip these tools that duplicate Jesse official MCP:
- jesse_status (→ get_jesse_status)
- get_exchanges (→ get_config)
- strategy_list (→ read_strategy)
- strategy_read (→ read_strategy)
- strategy_validate (→ create_strategy validates inline)
- candles_import (→ import_candles)

Keep: backtest, backtest_cancel, active_workers, backtest_benchmark (or remove backtest/backtest_cancel too if deferring to official).

File: jesse_mcp/tools/backtesting.py
Update: jesse_mcp/server.py tool registration counts, AGENTS.md, README.md
resolution: Removed overlapping tools, updated server.py docstrings

title: Remove overlapping strategy CRUD tools from tools/strategy.py
description:
Strip these tools that duplicate Jesse official MCP:
- strategy_create (→ create_strategy)
- strategy_delete (→ write_strategy can overwrite)
- strategy_refine (→ read_strategy + write_strategy cycle)
- strategy_metadata (→ read_strategy)

Keep: strategy_create_status, strategy_create_cancel, jobs_list, rate_limit_status, cache_stats, cache_clear (our async job infrastructure is unique).

File: jesse_mcp/tools/strategy.py
resolution: Removed overlapping tools, updated server.py docstrings
